subject.title: Control UI fails to load on Firefox desktop behind reverse proxy — CSP blocks Vite runtime eval(), 'Control UI did not start', WebSocket 1006

question: Should this issue stay open as the Firefox reverse-proxy/WebSocket investigation while the overlapping CSP/Zod fix is handled under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/78362, or should maintainers consolidate the reports now?
rationale: The source evidence supports the strict-CSP/Zod overlap, but the reverse-proxy WebSocket 1006 symptom is not proven fixed and the obvious unsafe-eval workaround is a security-boundary downgrade.

options.title: Keep Separate Pending Live Proof
options.body: Keep this issue open for Firefox reverse-proxy/WebSocket proof while treating https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/78362 as the canonical strict-CSP/Zod thread.

options.title: Consolidate Into CSP Thread
options.body: Copy the reverse-proxy details to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/78362 and close this issue only if maintainers accept that the WebSocket failure is startup fallout from the CSP violation.

options.title: Accept CSP Relaxation
options.body: Allow unsafe-eval in the Control UI CSP only if maintainers explicitly accept the broader script-execution risk and require browser proof for the reverse-proxy path.

recommendation.title: Keep Separate Pending Live Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for Firefox reverse-proxy/WebSocket proof while treating https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/78362 as the canonical strict-CSP/Zod thread.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history across the Control UI CSP, bootstrap config, and gateway connection security boundary.
